reviewed_by: Delegated coding agent static review against live Binary Ninja 6.0.10601 MCP (retail PE view_1), radare2 6.2.0 CFG and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast on retail igi.exe; candidate source read from this worktree. No game process was executed and no runtime behavior is claimed.
review_basis: Retail 0x0040F370 was re-disassembled, re-decompiled and re-CFG'd through the live Binary Ninja view, independently recovered with radare2 6.2.0 and angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast. The candidate is scripts/GameNatives/humanplayer/0040F370-HumanPlayer_LoadParameters_9.cpp at sha256 966494cdd30bd41706b5984d6458640728dcff046fbe27e70bde1db8a4feade6 (recorded implementation.signature: unresolved). The evidence artifact digests are bound in this review.

signature_comparison.rationale: Binary Ninja reports "void*(void* arg1, struct human_player* arg2)" at 0x0040F370; radare2 recovers "fcn.0040f370 (int32_t arg_30h, int32_t arg_ch);". Both tools place the entry at 0x0040F370 and agree on the stack/register word count and cleanup; the difference is the level of type/argument-name detail, not the call frame.
